blocks.text: Fleetwood Tynehead homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Fleetwood Tynehead, October 2026. Detached houses: 122 listed at month end and 14 sold in October, a sales ratio of 11% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 141 listed at month end and 15 sold in October, a sales ratio of 11% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 65 sold over 5 months against an average of 136.2 listed, about 10.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 16 sold. Condos and townhomes: 84 sold over 5 months against an average of 137.8 listed, about 8.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 21 sold.

faq.q: Is Fleetwood Tynehead one neighbourhood or two?
faq.a: One board sub-area: SnapStats lists "Fleetwood Tynehead" as a single sub-area of the Surrey community, and the page's feed cards all carry that one label — while the City plans the ground under the Fleetwood Plan (Green Timbers Urban Forest in the west towards the ALR in the east), with the Tynehead name carried at its east end (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Fleetwood Tynehead?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 122 houses listed with 14 sold in the month and 141 condos and townhomes listed with 15 sold in the month in Fleetwood Tynehead. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Fleetwood Tynehead a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 11%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 11%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
